title: The batch gate runs under full item load and a drain
description: Runs the real loop cycle over a host heavy-job budget of two, both slots held by item merge trials and a heavy-work drain set: the batch gate starts its check at once in its reserved slot and verifies main, and no stall alarm stands (GY-3450).

steps.name: the batch gate verifies main while item trials fill the budget and a drain is set
